plainText:
Milyfa Town (Japanese: ミリーファタウン Milyfa Town) is an -exclusive location and one of the settings for Secrets of the Jungle.

==Trivia==
The name of the town was first mentioned in the Japanese version of Pokémon Masters EX by . In the English version of the game, it is merely referred to as "a town".
Milyfa Town's Pokémon Center appears as one of Rita's landscape photos in New Pokémon Snap. In the game, it is referred to as being in an unknown region other than Lental.
